file_type: PE32+ (x86-64) Windows console executable (MinGW-w64/GCC 13, with DWARF debug info and symbols)

injection_details.method: Classic DLL injection via CreateRemoteThread + LoadLibraryA
injection_details.target_discovery: CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(TH32CS_SNAPPROCESS=0x2, 0) then Process32First/Process32Next loop, comparing PROCESSENTRY32.szExeFile with strcmp against "explorer.exe"
injection_details.payload_write: OpenProcess(PROCESS_ALL_ACCESS=0x42A, FALSE, pid) -> VirtualAllocEx(hProc, NULL, strlen(path)+1, MEM_COMMIT|MEM_RESERVE=0x3000, PAGE_READWRITE=0x4) -> WriteProcessMemory(hProc, remoteBuf, path, len, NULL)
injection_details.thread_execution: manual_get_proc(kernel32, "LoadLibraryA"); CreateRemoteThread(hProc, NULL, 0, LoadLibraryA, remoteBuf, 0, NULL); WaitForSingleObject(thread, INFINITE); CloseHandle(thread); CloseHandle(proc)
injection_details.api_resolution: manual_get_proc walks the kernel32 export directory (MZ/PE header, export directory at PE+0x88, name pointer table / ordinal table / address table) to resolve CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, Process32First, Process32Next, OpenProcess, VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory, CreateRemoteThread, CloseHandle, WaitForSingleObject, and LoadLibraryA; none of these are in the import table
injection_details.dll_path: XOR-decrypted 32-byte path "IS*h`4%+=1-Ah\x08X`m2-AthWomB8hnamj" (see encryption_details), null-terminated on stack and written into explorer.exe

encryption_details.algorithm: Repeating-key XOR (custom xor_decrypt: for i in 0..len-1: data[i] ^= key[i % keylen])
encryption_details.key_storage: Hardcoded constant array g_xor_key in .rdata at RVA 0x4000 (file offset 0x2800), immediately before the plaintext API-name strings; the ciphertext (g_encrypted_dll_path, 32 bytes) is in .data at RVA 0x3000 (file offset 0x2600). WinMain copies the 32 ciphertext bytes to the stack, calls xor_decrypt(..., len=0x20, keylen=8), and appends a NUL.

decoded_strings.plaintext_api_strings_in_rdata: kernel32.dll, CreateToolhelp32Snapshot, Process32First, Process32Next, OpenProcess, VirtualAllocEx, WriteProcessMemory, CreateRemoteThread, CloseHandle, WaitForSingleObject, explorer.exe, LoadLibraryA

anti_analysis: peb_antidebug: anti_debug_check() reads PEB via gs:[0x60] and tests the byte at PEB+0x02 (BeingDebugged); WinMain exits immediately (returns 0, no injection) if a debugger is detected
manual_getprocaddress: injection-critical APIs are resolved at runtime by walking the kernel32 export directory (not present in the import table), evading static IAT-based detection
string_obfuscation: the injected DLL path is XOR-encrypted (repeating-key XOR, 8-byte key) and decrypted only on the stack at runtime
